turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay.
I'll stand. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
What phone call? Nobody called me, Hale. Owen showed me the gradebook on his phone.
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No, we can't. Flattery isn't evidence, and neither is a zero. What do you have besides a checker score?
